source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape with distant misty hills, a broad rippled lake, steep right-side cliffs, densely textured wooded slopes, hidden pavilion roofs, foreground rocky shoreline, and a small lower-right stream/cascade. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_left_mountain_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the distant rounded mountain ridge in the upper left, including the ochre-green wash slopes, soft crest line, scattered dark tree dots along the summit, and fading lower edge where it dissolves into mist. Exclude seals and empty sky above.
must_preserve: soft ochre and pale green washes
small black-blue tree and shrub dots on the crest

motifs.name: left_misty_foothills
motifs.description: Isolate the lower band of misty foothills beneath the distant ridge at left, with pale layered slopes, sparse ink vegetation marks, and the atmospheric white gap separating hill forms. Exclude the lake ripples below.
must_preserve: small dotted shrubs along hill shoulders
soft white mist openings between overlapping slopes

motifs.name: broad_rippled_lake
motifs.description: Isolate the visible lake surface across the left and middle of the painting, including the many fine horizontal and scalloped ripple strokes and pale wash variations. Do not include adjacent cliffs, rocks, trees, or buildings.
must_preserve: soft transitions where water fades into mist

motifs.name: right_sheer_cliff_face
motifs.description: Isolate the tall right-side cliff mass below the inscription area, including the vertical rock planes, dark dotted texture, green-ochre washes, and clinging shrubs. Exclude calligraphy and seals on the upper right.
must_preserve: dense black texture dots following cracks
small shrub clusters attached to ledges

motifs.name: secluded_pavilion_roofs
motifs.description: Isolate the partially hidden pavilion and building roof group nestled among trees on the middle-right slope, including visible gabled roof geometry, eaves, wall lines, and surrounding foliage that overlaps the structures. Exclude unrelated cliff faces beyond the immediate setting.
must_preserve: thin architectural linework for walls and eaves
tree branches crossing in front of roofs
muted tan and gray wash accents

motifs.name: central_rocky_grove_peninsula
motifs.description: Isolate the central rocky wooded peninsula projecting from the lower middle-left, with rounded green rock forms, dense shrub clusters, bare branching trees, and ink-dot texture. Exclude the pavilion roofs to the right and open lake to the left except where edges are needed.
must_preserve: dark clustered foliage and shrub brushwork

motifs.name: foreground_pine_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense foreground grove across the lower center, including dark pine-like needle clusters, pale twisting trunks, leafless branchwork, overlapping shrubs, and rounded rocks at the base. Avoid including the lower-right cascade as a separate motif.
must_preserve: ink dots and stippled moss on rocks

motifs.name: lower_right_stream_cascade
motifs.description: Isolate the small lower-right stream or cascade descending through rocks and trees, including the pale vertical water ribbons, bordering stones, and nearby foliage that frames the flow. Exclude the pavilion group above and broad foreground shoreline below where possible.
must_preserve: stepped rock edges around the cascade
soft green wash on adjacent stones
delicate contour lines showing the channel

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
